desc: HP IJS server for the GhostScript IJS client driver
u: hpijs - HP IJS server for the GhostScript IJS client driver
hpijs should never be called directly. GhostScript will run it if the IjsServer parameter is set to IjsServer=hpijs when invoking the IJS driver.

For more information, please refer to /usr/share/doc/hpijs, and to http://www.openprinting.org/.

http://hplip.sourceforge.net/
http://www.openprinting.org/ (search for hpijs driver)
